<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template 1914395 to the product molecule (which is the fluorinated piperidine SMILES "FC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)C1") to obtain its precursors. Using the apply_template tool will return the list of precursor SMILES.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "FC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)C1", "template_id": "1914395"}</action_input>
